# Syenxa Tech

> Syenxa Tech is an AI automation agency that builds custom AI calling agents (voice AI), omnichannel AI chatbots, high-performance Next.js websites, and AI-driven digital marketing for small and mid-sized businesses worldwide. Founded 2014. Contact: syenxatech@gmail.com, +1 289 796-3492.

## What we do
- AI Calling Agents: 24/7 inbound and outbound voice agents that answer calls, qualify leads, book appointments into Google Calendar / HubSpot / Salesforce / GoHighLevel, and hand off to humans when needed. Sub-second response latency.
- AI Chatbots: one bot across WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger, TikTok and website chat. One-time setup from $150 to $350 USD, 7-day free trial, delivered in about 3 working days.
- Website Development: custom Next.js websites, web apps and e-commerce built for Core Web Vitals and technical SEO. Pricing from $200 USD, delivered in 5 to 7 working days for standard sites.
- Digital Marketing & SEO: technical SEO, content, paid acquisition and AI marketing automation.
